title: Generative AI for Analyzing Participatory Rural Appraisal Data: An Exploratory Case Study in Gender Research

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' performance in accurately identifying, interpreting, and categorizing culturally specific visual elements and nuanced contexts from hand-drawn artifacts created by rural Indian communities.
Assessing the models' capabilities to accurately translate and interpret mixed-script and multilingual annotations (e.g., English, Hindi, and Malayalam) embedded within unstructured visual data.
